record.dic_text:
01417 g@duwd {ge-du:d'} 或 (陰性型) g@dudah {ge-du:-da:'}

源自 01413; TWOT - 313b; 陽性或陰性名詞

欽定本 - furrow 1, cutting 1; 2

1) 割痕, 犁溝
   1a) 犁溝 (#詩 65:10|)
   1b) 切痕 (表示哀痛的記號) (#耶 48:37|)

from 01413; TWOT - 313b; n m/f

1) something cut, furrow, cutting

   1b) cuttings (as a sign of mourning)
